title: Bank-Funding Reduction on Paloma Business Card Deposit Rates
content:
The card deposit rate of a Paloma Business debit-card deposit carries a bank-funding reduction, in percentage points, decided by the deposits received in the three months before the day the fee is worked out, counted from the day after the same calendar day three months earlier up to and including that day.

### Reduction clause

An account with three or more ACH credit deposits and no more than two debit-card deposits in that window earns a bank-funding reduction of 0.25 percentage points; an account with one or two ACH credit deposits and no more than two debit-card deposits earns 0.10 percentage points; any other account earns none. The reduction is taken off the card deposit rate in percentage points.

### Truth table

| ACH credit deposits in the window | Debit-card deposits in the window | Bank-funding reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or more | 2 or fewer | 0.25 percentage points |
| 1 or 2 | 2 or fewer | 0.10 percentage points |
| 0 | Any number | None |
| Any number | 3 or more | None |

Debit-card deposits in the window include the most recent one when it falls inside the window. Wire deposits are counted in neither column.

### Cases (hypothetical)

- 4 ACH credit deposits and 1 debit-card deposit: 0.25 percentage points.
- 2 ACH credit deposits and 2 debit-card deposits: 0.10 percentage points.
- 5 ACH credit deposits and 3 debit-card deposits: none.
